titles: 15 Things in Mom's 1960s Kitchen You'll Never See Again
15 Things Every 1960s Kitchen Had — Only People Over 60 Remember
15 Things in Every 1960s Kitchen That Have Vanished Forever
description_intro:
These 1960s kitchen things were in almost every home across the United States and Canada, and today they've all but vanished. Come take a slow walk back into Mom's avocado and harvest-gold kitchen: the percolator going blub-blub before dawn, the aluminum ice cube tray, the bread box by the toaster, the church key in the drawer and the wobbling gelatin mold at every potluck.

We'll remember washing and drying side by side, milk bottles on the doorstep, TV dinners on folding trays, and Mom's recipe box full of stained, handwritten cards. And number one? You can probably still hear it ring.

Which of these was in your mom's kitchen? Tell us where you grew up in the comments.
